main_text.p: tem qva potuit industria & labore im-probo luci restituit. Utramqve Morinus cùm Græcam tum Latinam in unum corpus redactam notatis versuum distinctionibus Parisiis edi curavit, Anno 1628, opus sane Theologis, qvi sacras Literas tractant, percommodum. Huic autem ne qvid deesset, præfationem, in qva de antiqvis scripturæ sacræ translationibus prolixè. disserit, atqve imprimis de Septuaginta Interpretum autoritate, tàm ex Patrum, qvàm Judæorum sententia, præmisit. Præcipuas etiam in illa præfatione ingentis, qvod Græcos inter & Hebræos codices reperitur, discriminis causas attingit, de his detrahit, ut illos extollat. Romanæ editionis præstantiam & sinceritatem mirè prædicat. Ho-[?] diernis contextus Hebræi exemplaribus, qvibus vitia non pauca inesse existimat, nec non iis, qvi toti à Masorethicis illis codicibus dependent, infensissimum se o-stendit. Et ut majorem invidiam Judæis, eorumqve seqvacibus concitet, profert autoritatem Pentateuchi Hebræo-

page.notes: "Ho-[?]" at the start of line 18: the word is read as "Hodiernis" but the first letters are doubtful. The catchword "Sama-" is the first word of the next page. The text is read from the scan with the long s rendered as s, and "Anno" set in italic.
